open_questions: MIXER, fix before mix_audio: scripts/mix_music.py ends a bed only at a title card or at the end of the video (the branch `if not ends_at_card: t_end = total`). This video has two cardless continuations (CH2 into CH3, CH6 into CH7), so the CH2 and CH6 rows would keep playing to the end of the file and double up with the CH3 and CH7 rows. The rows are written sample-continuous (CH3 source_in 112.61 = 41.65 + 70.96; CH7 source_in 99.71 = 37.45 + 62.26) and `bed_groups` lists each physical bed as ONE placement: the mixer should merge a `continues_from` row into the row before it (one input per bed group, the automation of both rows kept), or cut the earlier row at the start of the next row with no fade. kaspa-vprogs never hit this because all three of its beds started on cards.

LEVEL: seated at the last ruling Mike gave (kaspa-vprogs gate, 2026-09-28: hype beds 22 under, explainer 23 under), not the 17 default: A -22, B -23, C -23 (its peak tamed to 21 under), D -22, E -22, against a measured -18.0 LUFS VO. Each gain is computed from the loudness of the region the bed actually seats on (lufs_seat_reference), not the whole file. If he wants the beds hotter it is one number per bed: add the same dB to remotion_gain_db and to every absolute automation seat of that bed.

LIFTS: four automation rows RAISE a quiet region of the file by 6 dB instead of dipping (Bed A breakdown 15.0-30.0; Bed E build 363.46-386.3 and breakdowns 402.0-409.0, 440.1-444.75). They exist so no stretch reads as the bed having run out (house rule 10). mix_music.py handles them as absolute seats above the bed gain; listen for them in the chunk QA. If Mike prefers the natural drop-outs, delete the rows.

BED A: Fearless has a real 15 s breakdown inside the hook (spine 15-30). It is placed on purpose (the receipt read sits in it, the rebuild and the drop land on picture cuts) and lifted 6 dB. If Mike wants a wall of sound with no pull-back, the swap is `pathways` (shortlist pick 3, fresh, flat level 8 for 190 s, source_in 0.0, same seat).

BED C: `slow-rise` (shortlist pick 2) is used instead of `tome-of-fate` (pick 1). Both are fresh and both swell from a mid pad to an 8-9 peak, but the Slow Rise peak is 34 s long and then RETURNS to the pad, which is what lets the swell land on 'gold.' AND the honest line be spoken over the quiet pad. The Tome Of Fate peak runs 50 s and would still be at full weight under the not-backed-by-gold line. Slow Rise is ambient cinematic, not full orchestra: if Mike wants the orchestral weight more than the shape, swap to `Cody_Martin_Tome_Of_Fate_instrumental_full_3_06-5.wav` at source_in about 53 (swell onset near file 95 on F6) and extend the taming row to 260.0.

BED B: Afterlife measures aggression 63, on the punchy side for a subtle bed, though it carries the explainer_bed role in the catalog and its used span is very flat (LRA 4.0). It is seated 23 under. If it pokes through on the 10 s chunk QA, drop it to 24, or swap to `lightheart` (aggression 44; its instrumental full needs source_in 60 to skip a level 2-3 intro, and its outro goes quiet after file 148, so it would need a loop for the 120 s span).

ENDING: the hard stop of Bed E is on the ONSET of 'chain.' (470.16), the same convention Mike ruled for 'later.' on kaspa-vprogs. The spine ends 0.30 s after that, so the button only reads if the picture holds: recommend the comp hold the end card about 1.0 s past the last word so the reverb tail (file 144.2-145.5) rings out. If he would rather have music under the whole word, shift both Bed E in-points by +0.24 (CH6 37.69, CH7 99.95) and the stop lands on the END of 'chain.' (470.40), but then it is indistinguishable from the video simply ending.

CARD PAUSE: the breath maths assumes a 1.5 s title-card pause (0.4 s out-fade + 0.6 s air + 0.5 s in-fade). With a 1.0 s pause the air shrinks to 0.1 s; keep the pauses at 1.4 s or more, or drop fade_in_sec to 0.3 on CH2, CH4, CH5 and CH6.
